row.evidence: Drata's plans page lists SSO on every GRC tier and SCIM only inside the Trust Center (Assurance) feature set; the help centre says Drata logins are "restricted to users synced from the IdP" through API-based IdP connections, and no SCIM endpoint for the GRC platform is documented.
row.notes: Status changed from June (gated): no first-party page supports June's "SCIM (Okta-only) on Enterprise" for the Drata GRC platform. Drata pulls users and groups from Okta, Microsoft 365/Entra, Google Workspace, OneLogin, JumpCloud and others through API connections it runs (directory sync, up to 24 h lag), and SSO (via WorkOS) is limited to those synced users. SCIM appears on drata.com/plans only for the Trust Center / Assurance product (ex-SafeBase), on Assurance Advanced and Enterprise, Contact Sales. No prices are published ("Get Personalized Pricing"); June's flat ~$7.5K-$25K figures were third-party and are dropped. Pricing URL moved from /pricing (now redirects to the home page) to /plans.

plans.name: Assurance Foundation (Trust Center)
plans.notes: SAML/SSO (JIT) for Trust Center; SCIM not in this tier per the comparison table.

plans.name: Assurance Advanced (Trust Center)
plans.notes: SCIM listed for the Trust Center product only; Trust Center Open API access (1 key).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented for the Drata GRC platform. SCIM is listed for the Trust Center (Assurance Advanced and Enterprise) product only; its SCIM docs live on the SafeBase help centre and were not researched for this row.

auth.notes: Bearer API keys created in Settings > API Keys, expiring after 12 months by default, scoped per permission.

capabilities.notes: Users and Roles endpoints are read-only (List Roles, Get Role, List Users with Role, List Users, Get User). Personnel (compliance records) can be updated.

endpoints.purpose: List users with access to Drata

audit_log_api.notes: Events API records user and automated activity.

limitations.text: No API endpoint to create, invite, deactivate or delete Drata users.

okta.notes: OIN app is OIDC SSO only; user sync is Drata pulling from the Okta API with a service-account token.

entra.notes: Via Drata's Microsoft 365 IdP connection; no Entra gallery tutorial found (drata-tutorial 404).

fallbacks.other_sync: Drata-run API sync from the connected IdP (Okta, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, OneLogin, JumpCloud, PingOne and others), daily or ad hoc

No prices are published for any GRC or Assurance tier.

Public API plan availability is inferred from 'Open API Access' on the Foundation card; per-tier API limits are not stated.
